name: Mrs Mallow, Feeding Them Up
text: End of Turn: double your two smallest Hedgerow units' stats.
golden_text: End of Turn: double your four smallest Hedgerow units' stats.

source.note: Pass 3; amended tribe gates and provisional paper B/C rates in content/pass3/rates.json.

details: Smallest means Attack plus Health; ties use zigzag order. Can pick this. Shy units are skipped. Targets are selected before any gain; extra triggers cannot repeat multiplication.
golden_details: Smallest means Attack plus Health; ties use zigzag order. Can pick this. Shy units are skipped. Targets are selected before any gain; extra triggers cannot repeat multiplication.
